mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_table_column_config ( user_id, table_key, config_content, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{tableKey}, #{configContent}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp(3), #{updateBy}, current_timestamp(3) ) on duplicate key update config_content = values(config_content), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = current_timestamp(3)
